# Vacationist

> The free group trip planner. Vacationist helps groups plan trips together — voting on activities, splitting travel expenses, sharing packing lists, managing accommodations, and keeping everyone in sync in real time.

## TL;DR

Vacationist is a free group trip planning app for iOS, Android, and web. Groups vote on activities (five-tier system: must do → group blocker), split expenses with live balances and settle-up, share real-time packing/shopping lists, and store travel documents in an AES-256 encrypted vault. Anyone can join a trip via a single link with no account required. No ads, no tracking. Built in Switzerland by an independent developer.

## What is Vacationist?

Vacationist is a free mobile and web application for group travel planning. It is available on iOS (Apple App Store), Android (Google Play), and as a web app.

Key use cases:
- **Vacation trips** — the primary use case; full trip lifecycle from planning to packing
- **Bachelorette & group trips** — vote on activities, split costs, shared packing, everyone in the loop
- **Van life & road trips** — route planning, shared packing list, expense splitting for fuel and campsites
- **Family vacation planning** — shared calendar, accommodations, activity voting, expense tracking
- **Ski trips** — split chalet, lift passes, and gear rental costs; vote on rest days vs. resort days
- **Stag & bachelor party trips** — vote on activities, split deposits and group costs, no-account guest joins
- **Timeshare & vacation rentals** — coordinate arrivals, split running costs, shared shopping lists
- **Group day trips and weekenders** — lightweight coordination without a full travel agent
- **Bar and dinner nights** — vote on venue, split the bill
- **Hobby groups and clubs** — recurring meetups with shared costs

## Core Features

- **Activity voting** — suggest activities; group votes "must do", "like", "neutral", or "group blocker"
- **Expense splitting** — log costs, choose who paid, split equally or with custom amounts; automatic balance tracking; settle individually or all at once
- **Group chat** — dedicated real-time chat tab per trip; send, edit, and delete messages; organizers can moderate the conversation; paginated message history
- **Vacation tracker & shared calendar** — visual timeline of activities, transfers, and check-ins in the trip's timezone; off-calendar view of every day
- **Real-time shared lists** — shopping lists, packing checklists; concurrent updates across all group members; recipe-to-shopping-list sync
- **Transfer & flight management** — suggest flights, vote, record bookings, manage car rentals, assign passengers
- **Encrypted travel documents** — passport and ID details protected by biometric authentication and AES-256 encryption; temporary organiser access with revocation
- **Group sharing** — invite via single link; members join instantly, no account required to participate
- **Offline support** — mutations queued offline and replayed automatically on reconnect
- **Notifications** — push notifications for votes, expenses, and activity updates

## Comparisons

- **[Vacationist vs. Splitwise](https://vacationist.app/vs/splitwise/):** Splitwise is a mature, excellent pure expense tracker for ongoing shared finances (roommates, couples). Vacationist covers the same expense splitting plus trip planning, activity voting, shared lists, and no-account guest joins — built specifically for group trips, not everyday shared costs.
- **[Vacationist vs. Wanderlog](https://vacationist.app/vs/wanderlog/):** Wanderlog is the stronger itinerary-research tool — maps, place discovery, route optimization. Vacationist is the stronger group-coordination tool — voting, expense splitting, shared lists, and guests who join without an account.
- **[Vacationist vs. TripIt](https://vacationist.app/vs/tripit/):** TripIt automatically builds an itinerary from forwarded confirmation emails for one traveler. Vacationist has no email parsing, but adds what TripIt lacks entirely: group voting, expense splitting, shared lists, and no-account participation.
- **[Vacationist vs. Tricount](https://vacationist.app/vs/tricount/):** Tricount is a fast, focused, and popular (especially in Europe) expense-splitting app with strong multi-currency support. Vacationist matches its expense splitting and no-account participation, then adds trip planning, activity voting, shared lists, and encrypted travel documents.
- **[Vacationist vs. Troupe](https://vacationist.app/vs/troupe/):** Both are group-first trip coordination apps with polls and expense splitting. Vacationist differentiates on AES-256 encrypted travel document storage, offline-first sync for every user, and a fully free core app with no ads.

## Technology

- Platform: React Native (Expo), iOS + Android + Web
- Backend: Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, Realtime, Edge Functions)
- Offline: TanStack Query with MMKV persistence
- Security: AES-256 (pgcrypto), biometric auth, no tracking, no ads
